title: Which Demographics do LLMs Default to During Annotation?

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the distance between LLM-generated politeness and offensiveness annotations and those of human annotators from different age groups, and evaluating the impact of age-conditioned persona prompting on model outputs.

Measuring the distance between LLM-generated politeness and offensiveness annotations and those of human annotators from male, female, and non-binary groups, and evaluating the impact of gender-conditioned persona prompting.

Measuring the distance between LLM-generated politeness and offensiveness annotations and those of human annotators from different racial and ethnic groups (e.g., White, Black/African American, Asian, Hispanic or Latino), and evaluating the impact of race-conditioned persona prompting.

Measuring the distance between LLM-generated politeness and offensiveness annotations and those of human annotators with varying educational backgrounds and occupational statuses, and evaluating the impact of conditioning prompts on these specific socio-economic attributes.
